data.body: Decision (operator, 2026-10-30): option (1). Keep closing the Jira issue by default on local delete/archive, then retire the binding automatically once the close is confirmed; a `skip` mapping for deleted/archived retires the binding without touching Jira; delete/archive warn when the ticket is bound. Route the terminal transition through effective_status_map and add `archived`. The manual retire command is withdrawn: bindings are maintained automatically and users have no visibility into them. Verified root cause of the ADP report: a Copilot CLI agent session ran `rebar delete <id> --user-approved` on 19 bound stories (12:01-12:12 PDT 2026-10-29) to recreate them as epics, because rebar does not change an existing Jira issue type. The user had authorized deleting Jira items, not rebar tickets; the agent supplied --user-approved itself. Classify on 6531-de5e real state + ADP-61 To Do returns TERMINAL_TRANSITION.
